verdict.rationale: HumanLayer documents its own workflow phases (RPI, PRD-Oriented) that add review before implementation, and reviewers can comment on synced task documents. It does not document an enforced approval gate that blocks the agent from modifying the repository until an engineering lead signs off on scope and contract. missing for 10: explicit approve/reject gate on a spec or plan, enforcement that blocks repo writes until approval, a role- or permission-based approver (engineering lead), hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can approve a task's scope and contract before an agent is allowed to modify the repository

citations.quote: A change with unclear behavior or code shape needs more review before implementation.
Select the shortest workflow that gives you the review points you need.
